name: StreamScanner::push

test_list.description: Retains only the finite-width overlap and reports global byte offsets for a match split across chunks.
Rejects unbounded patterns and assertions whose result depends on bytes outside the current stream context.
Scans 1 GiB in 1 MiB chunks, checking exact offsets for 1,023 boundary-spanning matches.

inputs.name: chunk
inputs.description: A bounded byte chunk; the scanner rejects chunks above its configured maximum.

inputs.name: out
inputs.description: Caller-owned fixed-capacity storage for spans emitted from this chunk.

output_description: Number of spans emitted, with global offsets and bounded retained overlap.
